description: MissionMind corpus manifest. Curated fields are edited by hand; sha256, bytes and pages are computed by scripts/build_manifest.py and verified by tests/test_manifest.py. source_check records how the source was confirmed: 'size_match' = HTTP Content-Length equals the local file size (strong evidence, not a cryptographic proof); 'unverified' = source not yet confirmed.
